sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Paras Nath Rai Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1. Heard Shri Jai Singh Parihar, learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri P.N. Rai, learned counsel for respondent No. 4 and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Addl.
Chief Standing Counsel appearing for State-respondents.

2. The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent No. 3 to pay compensation to the petitioners for total six biswa of land (0.0680 hectare) of which possession had been taken by the respondents in pursuance of acquisition proceedings.

sentences.text: The Land Acquisition Officer (respondent No. 3) has filed an affidavit disclosing that the land of the petitioners was subjected to acquisition under the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956.
Section 3-A notification was issued on 16.03.2022 followed by notification under Section 3-D dated 14.09.2022/15.09.2022.
An award was declared on 30.11.2022.
The land of the petitioners and other co-tenure holders of Araji No. 105 total area 0.1748 hectare was acquired.
Since the area of the petitioners as per revenue records was 0.0100 hectare each and as such they were paid Rs.56,299.00 each.
Thereafter, the petitioners along with other co-tenure holders filed applications before him that in fact they had not been paid compensation for the entire area acquired but for lesser area.
Hence, an enquiry was got conducted and it transpires from the enquiry report dated 26.06.2024 that there was mistake in the revenue map.
It was showing less area than the actual area of Gata No. 105.

Consequently, proceedings for correction of map under Section 38 of U.P. Revenue Code, 2006 have been initiated and as soon as the map is corrected, the petitioners shall be paid compensation for the difference of land area.

4. In view of the aforesaid admission of the State-respondents, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the proceedings for correction of map be concluded expeditiously and the petitioners be paid compensation for difference in area preferably within three months from today.
Order Date :- 8.8.2024

Mukesh Kr.
(Manish Kumar Nigam,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
